description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring an Early Career Software Engineer for its Rotary & Mission Systems Mission Systems Engineering team. The role develops embedded Board Support Package (BSP) and Built-in-Test (BIT) software for custom hardware, including writing requirements, coding, integration, and lab verification.
Early-Career Software Engineer developing embedded BSP and Built-in-Test software, writing requirements, coding, integrating, and verifying custom hardware solutions

Responsibilities:
• In this role, you will work closely with a multi-discipline team of engineers to develop embedded Board Support Package (BSP) and Built-in-Test (BIT) software for our custom hardware solutions
• You will write requirements, develop source code, integrate, and verify software in a lab environment

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent STEM computing field
• Academic or professional experience using C
• Academic or professional experience on at least one team-based project
• Must be a US Citizen
• This position will require a government security clearance
• This position is located at a facility that requires special access
• The successful candidate will also be flexible, motivated, detail-focused, and team-oriented

Preferred:
• Experience with C, Linux-based operating systems, and team-based software projects
• Experience writing or debugging hardware control software, bootloaders, or using programmable single board computers (such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar)
• Experience using instrumentation to analyze and debug systems (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, serial console)
• Experience using, developing for, or building software within Linux
• Basic understanding of software development methodologies (especially Agile)
• Basic understanding of software life-cycle development stages, activities, and process
• Experience with Git/GitLab, Visual Studio, Fortify, or Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence)
